subject: Mystic Valley Highway Water Bill Appeal
overview: The Commission met to consider a resident's appeal regarding a high water bill and billing errors. No final decision was reached, and the matter was tabled for further investigation.

items.title: High Water Bill Appeal for 44-46 Mystic Valley Highway
items.summary: Tabled an appeal for a high water bill totaling over $22,000 to allow for a city-funded meter test and an investigation into why billing notifications were not received by the owner. The homeowner reported that sediment in toilet valves caused a continuous leak and that bills were being sent to the previous owner at the property address rather than her residence.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the previous meeting.
